definition:
Pulled to sit: Head lag and rounded back.Ventral Suspension: Head held up momentarily in same plane as body.Prone: Pelvis high but knees no longer under abdomen.Chin raised intermittently off couch. 
Head turned to one side.

Pulled to sit: Only slight head lag.Head occasionally bobs forward. 
Ventral Suspension: Head held up above plane of body. 
Prone: Pelvis flat. 
Lifts head up 45° - 90°, weight supported on forearms

Pulled to sit: Lifts head off couch. 
Sits with support. 
Bears full weight on legs. 
Prone: Supports weight on hands with chest and upper part of abdomen off couch. 
Rolls over from prone to supine at 5-6 mths, supine to prone at 6-7 mths.

Sits steadily. 
Leans forward to pick toy without losing balance. 
Pulls self to stand. 
Stands holding on to furniture. 
Progresses on the floor by rolling, wriggling on abdomen or crawling.

Gets from lying to sitting to crawling to standing. 
Walks on hands and feet like a bear. 
Walks with one hand held. 
Stands alone. 
May walk alone.

Creeps up stairs. 
Walks alone with broad based gait.

Walks well, runs rather stiffly though seldom falls. 
Carry large doll or teddy while walking. 
Walks up and downstairs with help. 
Squats to pick up toy.

Runs safely, avoiding obstacles. 
Goes up and down stairs alone, 2 feet per step. 
Able to walk backward pulling toy handle. 
Walks into large ball while trying to kick it.

Jumps with 2 feet together from a low step. 
Stand on tiptoe if shown. 
Kicks large ball gently

Goes up stairs one foot per step and down stairs 2 feet per step. 
Walk on tiptoe. 
Stands on 1 foot momentarily. 
Rides tricycle. 
Kicks ball forcibly, throw a ball overhand.

Walks or runs up and down stairs one foot per step. 
Stand, walk and run on tiptoe. 
Stands on one foot for 3-5 seconds and hops on one foot.

Walks on narrow line. 
Skips on alternate feet. 
Balance on one foot for 8-10 seconds. 
Dances to music.
